name: EventWave Event / Venue Promotion
problem: An organizer or venue wants a bounded paid EventWave placement with verified payment, source review and controlled activation.
inputs: Choose Event Boost or Venue Pack, provide contact email and the relevant public event or venue identifiers/URL.
outputs: Verified order state, source-review state, bounded activated placement, placement expiry and activation evidence.
pricing: Event Boost $49 one-time; Venue Pack $149 one-time.
confirmation: Explicit purchase confirmation and verified payment are required. Source review must pass before any public placement activates.
invocation_status: MIGRATION HOLD: legacy Base44 route removed. Use Evercraft Fabric for discovery; direct execution, checkout and fulfillment require independent owned-runtime verification.
authority_rule: Discovery never creates a payment obligation. Checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation when supported. Checkout creation is not proof of payment. Paid state and fulfillment require authoritative provider verification.
